messages:
jun (Customer): Hey team — seeing intermittent 504s from the API starting around 2026-03-18T09:12:34Z. No request-id shows up in our UI, just the generic network error. Screenshot attached.

lauren (Support): Thanks for the heads-up — can you paste the exact client timestamp and a short description of the steps that lead to the failure (single request, bulk, streaming, sequence lengths)? We also need either a HAR from the browser or a minimal curl that reproduces. If you have a screenshot + network panel that helps.

jun (Customer): Timestamp: 2026-03-18T09:12:34Z. Steps: single synchronous request from our server backend (Node). Intermittent ~1/20 requests fail. Screenshot uploaded to the ticket. Minimal curl I used locally: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hello world"}'
```

lauren (Support): Nice — can you also turn on client debug so we get the SDK-level request id? For the Node SDK set `process.env.REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG = '1'` before instantiating the client, or do `client.debug = true` and reproduce once. That should log a `x-rw-req-id` (or similar) value in your stdout. If you can't run the SDK, please attach the HAR.

kevin (SRE): One more thing — when it fails, capture the full response headers (we look for `x-rw-req-id`, `x-server-ts`, `x-rw-route`) and the client-side timestamp. If you're behind a proxy or CDN (CloudFront/Cloudflare) include any edge request IDs as well. If possible, include a small pcap or proxy logs.

jun (Customer): Ok I enabled SDK debug and reproduced. Log line we got: `RW_DBG: req_id=rw_9a1b2c3d status=504 latency_ms=1212 route=eu-west-1`. HAR uploaded to the ticket. I redacted the Authorization header.

lauren (Support): Perfect — thanks. Please also add a 1-line description of traffic pattern (QPS and whether requests are bursty) and approximate payload sizes. That helps us rule out connection reuse or payload-related timeouts.

eng-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-1642 (linked to support ticket).

kevin (SRE): I'll search the runtime traces for `rw_9a1b2c3d` and pull server-side logs. If the req_id doesn't appear in our system we'll need the client and server timestamp pair to correlate.

lauren (Support): If you need to redact anything, just replace values with `<REDACTED>` but keep headers and timestamps intact. Once the HAR + SDK log line are on the ticket I'll escalate to runtime with the req_id + HAR. Ping me when uploaded and I'll push it over. :thumbsup:
